versions.changelog:
- Added detailed Chinese-language documentation and guides (`guide-zh-CN.md`, `pricing.md`) to support users in both English and Chinese.
- Moved documentation files into organized subfolders (`AIsa Chinese Models v3/`, `references/`).
- Removed duplicated top-level guide and pricing files in favor of new structured documentation.
- No changes to provider configuration or API usage—this update is documentation and structure only.

Initial release of AIsa as an OpenClaw model provider, enabling access to leading Chinese LLMs.

- Adds AIsa as a first-class provider for OpenClaw, integrating Chinese AI models including MiniMax, Qwen, DeepSeek, Kimi K2.5, and Doubao.
- Supports rapid onboarding via environment variable, CLI, interactive setup, or manual config.
- Provides pre-configured, API-verified access to major models with sample pricing and feature tables.
- Highlights discounted pricing (e.g., Kimi K2.5 at ~80% of official rates) and enterprise Zero Data Retention for privacy-sensitive workloads.
- Documents temperature constraint for Kimi K2.5 and explains best practices for configuration and model selection.
- Includes instructions for listing and adding additional AIsa-supported models.
